- Removed the file: skill-card.md.  
- No other changes to core functionality or documentation.

Initial release of the Tool Economy skill.

- Introduces principles for minimizing tool call overhead by batching, caching, and consolidating actions.
- Provides guidelines to agents on reducing redundant calls and tracking a “tool budget” for efficiency.
- Includes quick-reference tables, checklists, and anti-patterns to encourage best practices in tool usage.
- Supplies scripts and documentation for analyzing session efficiency and maximizing economy.
- Suitable for any agent handling multiple tool invocations to optimize cost and latency.
